# SurfaceOne — component catalogue

Install: `npm install @surface-one/angular @surface-one/tokens`. One entry point per component family; import from it.

## Layout

Recording, playback, transcripts and timelines.

### Audio Player

A slim recording player with skip, progress, time and playback speed.

- Import: `import { SoneAudioPlayerComponent } from "@surface-one/angular/audio-player";`
- Selectors: `sone-audio-player`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/audio-player/

### Recording

Record button, microphone toggle, level meter, status orb, elapsed timer, recording indicator and processing status for capture UIs.

- Import: `import { SoneElapsedTimerComponent, SoneLevelMeterComponent, SoneMicToggleComponent, SoneProcessingStatusComponent, SoneRecordButtonDirective, SoneRecordingIndicatorComponent, SoneStatusOrbComponent } from "@surface-one/angular/recording";`
- Selectors: `sone-elapsed-timer`, `sone-level-meter`, `sone-mic-toggle`, `sone-processing-status`, `button[soneRecordButton]`, `sone-recording-indicator`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/recording/

### Floating Bar

The pill that floats over every app while recording is ready, live or processing, with a close button.

- Import: `import { SoneFloatingBarComponent } from "@surface-one/angular/floating-bar";`
- Selectors: `sone-floating-bar`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/floating-bar/

### Transcript

A turn-grouped, click-to-seek transcript.

- Import: `import { SoneSpeakerInitialsPipe, SoneTranscriptComponent } from "@surface-one/angular/transcript";`
- Selectors: `sone-transcript`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/transcript/

### Live Transcript

The caption log of a recording in progress.

- Import: `import { SoneLiveTranscriptComponent } from "@surface-one/angular/live-transcript";`
- Selectors: `sone-live-transcript`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/live-transcript/

### Timeline

Lanes of blocks and a chapter ribbon on one time scale, with a playhead, chapters and legend.

- Import: `import { SoneTimelineChaptersComponent, SoneTimelineComponent, SoneTimelineLegendComponent } from "@surface-one/angular/timeline";`
- Selectors: `sone-timeline-chapters`, `sone-timeline`, `sone-timeline-legend`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/timeline/

### Speaker Chip

A speaker’s initials in a tone-coloured avatar plus their name, derived from one transcript speaker key.

- Import: `import { SoneSpeakerChipComponent } from "@surface-one/angular/speaker-chip";`
- Selectors: `sone-speaker-chip`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/speaker-chip/

## Flow

Draw diagrams and workflows: a node canvas with edges, controls, a minimap and a tool dock.

### Flow

A node canvas for diagrams and workflows — draggable nodes, curved edges with labels, connecting handles, pan and zoom, controls and a minimap.

- Import: `import { SoneFlowComponent, SoneFlowControlsComponent, SoneFlowMinimapComponent, SoneFlowNodeTemplateDirective, SoneFlowPanelDirective } from "@surface-one/angular/flow";`
- Selectors: `sone-flow`, `sone-flow-controls`, `sone-flow-minimap`, `ng-template[soneFlowNode]`, `[soneFlowPanel]`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/flow/

### Dock

A toolbar of drawing tools that docks to the top, bottom, left or right edge of a canvas, with arrow-key navigation and tooltips.

- Import: `import { SoneDockComponent, SoneDockGroupDirective, SoneDockItemDirective, SoneDockSeparatorDirective } from "@surface-one/angular/dock";`
- Selectors: `sone-dock`, `[soneDockGroup]`, `button[soneDockItem]`, `[soneDockSeparator]`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/dock/
